**Tradition** — sanskrit / tamil-shaiva / tamil-vaishnava / north-bhakti / jain / folk:

### Before this can merge

- [ ] The locus is real. I opened the edition named in `checkedAgainst` and the episode is where the file says it is.
- [ ] Nothing in the text is absent from the source. No invented characters, no invented dialogue beyond ordinary retelling, no borrowed detail from another tradition presented as this one.
- [ ] If the recensions differ, `stability` says so and `traditionNote` explains it in the parent's words.
- [ ] Age floor is honest. I would read this, tonight, to a child of exactly that age.
- [ ] Sensitivities are flagged and `careNote` tells a parent what is coming before they start.
- [ ] Short and full are separately written. The short one is not the long one with paragraphs deleted.
- [ ] I read both lengths out loud, all the way through, without stumbling.
- [ ] Every name has a lexicon entry with native script, respelling and gloss.
- [ ] The question at the end is open. It cannot be answered right or wrong.
- [ ] `npm run validate` is clean, and `npm run lock` has been run and committed.
